description: Kernel command lines and the host export that nvx::protocol::export parses from each, null for none, or the error with which it refuses the command line. The tests of nvx-rs replay them.

cases.name: the tokens of a managed sandbox and of the VMM
cases.command_line: quiet nvx_sandbox=1 nvx_layer=distro,0xd0003000,erofs:0123abcd-4567-89ef-0123-456789abcdef nvx_scratch=0xd0006000,ext4 nvx_entrypoint=/bin/sh nvx_hostname=nvx-sandbox nr_cpus=1 nvx_workload_uid=65534 nvx_workload_gid=65534 nvx_lifecycle=managed nvx_maps=2 virtio_mmio.device=0x1000@0xd0003000:4 virtio_mmio.device=0x1000@0xd0006000:11 virtio_mmio.device=0x1000@0xd0007000:3 nvx_control_tty=hvc2 virtio_mmio.device=0x1000@0xd0001000:6 virtfs_dir=/run/nvx/hostfs/root virtfs_tag=microvm virtfs_mode=rw virtfs_aggregate=1

cases.name: the tokens of an adapter's layered root and of the VMM
cases.command_line: console=hvc0 nvx_layer=distro,0xd0003000,gpt:fedcba98-7654-3210-fedc-ba9876543210 nvx_overlay_upper=ramfs virtio_mmio.device=0x1000@0xd0003000:4 virtio_mmio.device=0x1000@0xd0001000:6 virtfs_dir=/run/nvx/hostfs/root virtfs_tag=microvm virtfs_mode=ro virtfs_aggregate=1

cases.name: a tag of every kind of byte that a tag may hold
a parameter named nvx_share without a value, which binds nothing
parameters whose names only begin like the export's
cases.command_line: virtfs_dirs=/x virtfs_tags=t virtfs_modes=rw virtfs_aggregates=1 virtfs=1 virtfs_aggregate_count=2 xvirtfs_dir=/run/nvx/hostfs/root nvx_shares=0,/workspace,rw

cases.name: no export, as for a guest that the host maps no paths into
a single shared directory
cases.error: the virtfs_dir kernel parameter must be /run/nvx/hostfs/root, not '/workspace'

cases.name: the aggregate of a one-shot sandbox's live shares
cases.error: the virtfs_dir kernel parameter must be /run/nvx/hostfs/root, not '/run/nvx/shares'

cases.name: the export's parent
cases.error: the virtfs_dir kernel parameter must be /run/nvx/hostfs/root, not '/run/nvx/hostfs'

cases.name: a directory below the export
cases.error: the virtfs_dir kernel parameter must be /run/nvx/hostfs/root, not '/run/nvx/hostfs/root/0'

cases.name: the directory with a trailing slash
cases.error: the virtfs_dir kernel parameter must be /run/nvx/hostfs/root, not '/run/nvx/hostfs/root/'

cases.name: the directory through a dot component
cases.error: the virtfs_dir kernel parameter must be /run/nvx/hostfs/root, not '/run/nvx/./hostfs/root'

cases.name: a relative directory
cases.error: the virtfs_dir kernel parameter must be /run/nvx/hostfs/root, not 'run/nvx/hostfs/root'

cases.name: an empty directory
cases.error: the virtfs_dir kernel parameter must be /run/nvx/hostfs/root, not ''

cases.name: a directory without a value
cases.error: the virtfs_dir kernel parameter has no value

cases.name: a tag without a value
cases.error: the virtfs_tag kernel parameter has no value

cases.name: a mode without a value
cases.error: the virtfs_mode kernel parameter has no value

cases.name: the aggregate's token without its value
cases.error: the virtfs_aggregate kernel parameter has no value

cases.name: an empty tag
cases.error: the virtfs_tag kernel parameter must be a tag of letters, digits, _, and -, not ''

cases.name: a tag with a dot
cases.error: the virtfs_tag kernel parameter must be a tag of letters, digits, _, and -, not 'a.b'

cases.name: a tag with a slash

cases.name: another mode

cases.error: the virtfs_dir kernel parameter is repeated
